# PromptForge
> Free, high-precision AI prompt engineering and optimization platform built by Suman Verse.

PromptForge transforms short, vague requests into structured, production-ready AI directives formatted for state-of-the-art models including OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Google Gemini 2.0, and DeepSeek-R1.

## Core Capabilities
- **Prompt Generator**: Multi-tier reasoning generator with strict guardrails (anti-hallucination, zero-placeholders, unit-test mandates).
- **Prompt Optimizer**: AI-driven refiner providing 5-metric quality scoring (Clarity, Specificity, Context, Constraints, Format).
- **Curated Prompt Library**: Production-tested prompts spanning Software Engineering, Study/Education, Technical Writing, Research, Business, Marketing, and Career workflows.

## Prompt Engineering Architecture
Prompts generated by PromptForge follow the 5-Pillar Architecture:
1. Role & Senior Authority Framing
2. Direct, Unambiguous Objective Definition
3. Deep Domain Context & Environment Specifications
4. Explicit Negative Constraints (anti-patterns to reject)
5. Strict Schema & Output Formatting

For exhaustive documentation and raw prompt datasets, see:
https://promptforge.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
